integrity.mathematical_scope: A single finite geometric-quotient classification with four natural subgroup cases.
integrity.proof_dependencies: Explicit acyclic matching, all barycentric orbit-chain boundary ranks over F2, transfer of homology after inverting two, Armstrong's orbit fundamental-group theorem, and Hurewicz/Whitehead.
integrity.reproducibility: python3 verify.py; expected exact output verification_output.txt.

limitations: Only the four nontrivial symmetry-subgroup quotients of the 3-by-4 grid matching complex are classified. The argument does not address arbitrary widths, other metrics, or equivariant homotopy splittings.
title: Integral homotopy types of all reflection quotients of the three-by-four grid matching complex
